_about: Evidence chain reconstructed from the appendix of the Leverock's Great Seafood report that scored 77/100 (audit cmvoqcs6u0002kw08rfmgydre, generated 2026-10-26 on main a00bbde). Public-website facts only, as printed in that report; confidence is the printed label (Strong/Moderate/Preliminary). Read-only test input: nothing writes it to any database.

records.fact: No public reservation pathway could be resolved, but a SpotHopper widget was detected on the page.

records.fact: Ordering is offered by telephone: the ordering call-to-action on the website places a phone call rather than opening an online ordering page.
records.ctx: Call-to-action text: "Order" linked to a telephone number. An ordering destination is also declared in the page markup (https://tmt.spotapps.co/order- ing-menu/?spot_id=), but the action a customer is actually offered is the phone call above, so it is recorded as context rather than as a working online ordering pathway. Whether that destination is reachable for customers requires manual validation.

records.fact: A contact pathway is publicly available by telephone and a published email address, but no contact page or verified enquiry form was detected, and a form was found whose purpose could not be established.
records.ctx: Phone number published: (727) 367-4588. Click-to-call (tel:) links are present. Public email address published: leverocksgreatseafood@gmail.com. 1 form(s) whose purpose could not be established are recorded separately and are not counted as routes. Customers can reach the restaurant by phone or in writing; what happens to a written enquiry, and how fast, is not observable from the public site. Based on 8 analyzed page(s).
